summary: All requested partner-role features passed real public API and browser testing. Final pytest: 14/16 pass; two pre-existing password-auth safeguards fail (no application httpOnly cookie, no five-failure lockout). All seven roles log in through the same screen and reach their correct dashboards. All four partner portals show consent-gated empty queues; patient/doctor/admin and anonymous lab-route guards work. No product code changed.

critical.issue: No lockout after five failed password attempts on a disposable partner account: five 401s followed immediately by successful 200 login. Reproduced in both pytest runs. Pre-existing auth safeguard, not a partner provisioning failure.

minor.issue: Password login returns JWT but sets no application authentication httpOnly cookie. Infrastructure Set-Cookie headers initially caused a false positive; corrected test checks actual auth cookies. Frontend stores JWT in localStorage. Pre-existing architecture differs from requested auth-playbook safeguard.

action_items: Requested partner-role change is functionally verified; no blocker found in signup rejection, protected provisioning, role redirects or empty-queue privacy.
Address baseline password-login throttling/lockout and decide on secure cookie-based authentication rather than localStorage JWT; retest safeguards after implementation.
Review provisioning rollback/concurrent duplicate-email handling before production.
critical_code_review_comments: Code-only: provision_partner checks email before insert, then creates the identity before hashing/inserting the user; no transaction/rollback or DuplicateKeyError handling exists. Concurrent duplicates or hashing/insertion failures can produce 500s/orphan identities. Not reproduced in this scoped run.

Code-only: several shared app routes (documents, OCR, records, appointments, consultations, billing) use Protected without role lists, so partners can directly visit patient-style workspaces despite partner-only navigation. Tested self-scoped read APIs return empty arrays and explicit other-patient requests return 403; no patient leak found. Add explicit role policy before expanding partner workflows.

success_rate.backend: 87.5% (14/16 final tests); all requested feature checks pass

test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md and /app/auth_testing.md first; documented patient, doctor, admin and lab credentials all authenticated. No documented account modified. Alternate auth-testing.md absent.
seed_data_creation: No seed/reset/migration run. Disposable TEST_ partners provisioned only through documented admin API. All created users and identities removed by captured user IDs and cleanup verified; normal audit records retained. No public partner account created, no existing patient data changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Source frontend/.env and run pytest backend/tests/test_partner_access.py. Final output is partner_access_retest.xml. Initial validation failure was only a test-helper role argument collision and was corrected; infrastructure cookies no longer falsely satisfy auth-cookie check. Lockout reproduces twice. Browser run invokes run(page) using an explicit exec scope. Remaining-role browser initially failed before any account creation because browser runner lacks pymongo; moved setup/cleanup to bash fixture helper, then all three portals passed. To rerun alternate roles: python tests/partner_ui_fixtures.py setup; execute browser playbook; always python tests/partner_ui_fixtures.py cleanup. Fixture credential file was removed after verified cleanup. Reviewed backend logs show five 401s followed by 200 and no current traceback. Bcrypt hashes start $2b$; public-origin credentialed CORS preflight passed. No seed_admin implementation found, so idempotency was not executed. External OAuth/ABDM/LLM/payment services were not invoked. No APIs MOCKED. Consent/task fulfillment is intentionally unimplemented and portals correctly remain empty, not a simulated task integration. Requested integration_playbook_expert_v2/test_finish tools were unavailable; used local auth instructions and available finish tool.
